For terms whose entire operative meaning is 'has the meaning provided in Section X' (Retained Asset Sale Proceeds, Retained Declined Proceeds, Second Commitment Application Period), the cross-referenced sections were successfully retrieved via getReferencedProvision and are reflected as COMPLETE. For 'Sanctioned Country' the cross-referenced Section 3.17(a) was retrieved but truncated before the defining clause, so it is MISSING_CONTEXT. For 'RFR Interest Day' and 'RFR Lookback Day', the internal cross-reference to 'Daily Simple RFR' could not be retrieved because the tool-call budget was exhausted after other, higher-priority retrievals - marked MISSING_CONTEXT rather than guessed.

The Frozen Semantic Inventory for this unit reported an INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP with only aggregate statistics (counts and unaccounted character ranges) and did not surface individually addressable inventoryItemIds in the material supplied to this compiler, so no inventoryItemIds could be attached to nodes and inventoryDispositions is empty; the only deterministically-flagged quantitative value (MONEY $0) was located and consumed in the 'Revolving Commitment' definition (d6).

The 30 generic 'UNRESOLVED_DEFINED_TERM (LOW)' flags supplied in context correspond to numerous ordinary dependent terms used across this glossary run (e.g. Unrestricted Subsidiary, Foreign Subsidiary, SONIA, Daily Simple RFR, Incremental Revolving Facility, Other Revolving Facility, OFAC, Governmental Authority, Prepayment Event, Loan, Lender, Person, etc.) that are declared elsewhere in the instrument's own alphabetical glossary outside the text supplied to this compiler; they are listed in each definition's dependsOnTerms and did not block compiling the categorical definitions themselves, since most of these definitions are non-computational cross-references rather than formulas dependent on those terms' own numeric content.

'Retained Excess Cash Flow' (d4) is the only genuinely formulaic definition in this batch; it is PARTIAL because (i) 'Retained Excess Cash Flow Percentage' was confirmed via getDefinition to be undefined anywhere in this instrument, and (ii) clause (a)'s multi-period summation exceeds the fixed-arity SUM/ADD primitives (see irExtensionCandidates).

irExtensionCandidates.semanticRequirement: A construct that sums a per-period computed amount across every period in an open-ended, date-bounded historical range (e.g. 'each Excess Cash Flow Period ending after the Closing Date and prior to the determination date') where the number of periods is not fixed at drafting time and grows as time passes.
irExtensionCandidates.whyExistingPrimitivesFail: SUM/ADD require an explicit, fixed operands array; there is no primitive for 'apply this per-period formula to every period in [dynamic range] and sum the results,' so the aggregation itself (as opposed to any single period's amount) cannot be represented without either fabricating a fixed operand list or discarding the range semantics.
irExtensionCandidates.candidateGeneralizedPrimitive: A PERIODIC_SUM node: {kind: 'PERIODIC_SUM', perPeriodExpression, periodSeriesDescription, fromBound, toBound} that sums perPeriodExpression evaluated once per period in the described series between the bounds, without requiring the caller to enumerate periods.
